items.a: Run the production prompt/model several times on the same inputs; its **self-agreement (~93% here) is the realistic bar** for any candidate.

items.q: What should every model call record?
items.a: Prompt version, model settings, token usage, latency and cost, **linked into one trace per task** (e.g. OpenTelemetry).

items.q: In what order do you cut cost?
items.a: **Prefix caching**, then **shrink the prompt** with an optimizer (DSPy + GEPA), then **downsize or split the model**.
Replaced long worked examples with compact rules: **51% fewer instruction tokens** with the same interface contract.

items.q: When is a cheaper candidate shippable?
items.a: When the **paired confidence interval on net gain** (improvements minus regressions) has a **lower bound above zero** and critical categories hold separately.
